claims.statement: The finished kolam has 41 pulli (dots); by distance from the centre: 1 at radius ~0 px, 8 at radius ~44 px, 8 at radius ~88 px, 8 at radius ~131 px, 8 at radius ~175 px, 8 at radius ~219 px.
The line work forms 1 continuous line (a closed loop) when every one of the 32 crossings is read as two lines passing straight through.
The pattern has 8-fold rotational symmetry about its centre and no mirror symmetry (it turns in one direction).
40 dots lie on the line (it passes through them); 1 is enclosed by the line without touching it.
Every line in the image belongs to these continuous lines: there are no loose ends and no stray marks.

Suggested stage 1 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (49% across, 7% down) to (18% across, 82% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): Start at the top dot (49% across, 7% down) and draw a curve down to the bottom-left dot (18% across, 82% down).

Suggested stage 2 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (18% across, 82% down) to (94% across, 51% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the bottom-left dot, curve upwards and across to the far-right dot (94% across, 51% down).

Suggested stage 3 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (94% across, 51% down) to (18% across, 20% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the far-right dot, curve up and left to the top-left dot (17% across, 20% down).

Suggested stage 4 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (18% across, 20% down) to (49% across, 95% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the top-left dot, curve down to the bottom-center dot (50% across, 95% down).

Suggested stage 5 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (49% across, 95% down) to (81% across, 20% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the bottom-center dot, curve up and right to the top-right dot (80% across, 20% down).

Suggested stage 6 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (81% across, 20% down) to (5% across, 51% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the top-right dot, curve left to the far-left dot (5% across, 52% down).

Suggested stage 7 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (5% across, 51% down) to (81% across, 82% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the far-left dot, curve down to the bottom-right dot (81% across, 82% down).

Suggested stage 8 of 8 (one possible way, inferred from the final image; line C1): without lifting, draw from (81% across, 82% down) to (49% across, 7% down), passing through 6 dots. Model wording (inferred): From the bottom-right dot, curve up to return to the starting top dot (49% across, 7% down).

Model description of the image (inferred, unverified): A complex geometric pattern consisting of a single continuous white line that loops around a central dot. The pattern is composed of multiple overlapping circular arcs that create a symmetrical, flower-like shape against a black background.
